sloka: यथा च स महाबाहुर्मां तारयति राघवः ।असमाद्दुःखाम्बुसंरोधात्त्वं समाधातुमर्हसि ।। ५.६७.३६ ।।।।
transliteration: yathā ca sa mahābāhurmāṁ tārayati rāghavaḥ ।asamādduḥkhāmbusaṁrodhāttvaṁ samādhātumarhasi ।। 5.67.36 ।।।।

translations.english: "'that today I may show you your lord Raghava, greatly blessed and dark-eyed one, with Sugriva and with Lakshmana.'
